title: SAMPLED GROUND
rule: the page takes its colour from the screen it shows; nobody picks a colour
description: Six products from 2023 to 2026, oldest first, as six big side-column cards. Each card's panel and the page ground are computed from the dominant hue of the card's own screen at fixed lightness and chroma, so the page changes colour when the product changes. A hue scale in the bar, labelled 'hue 0° … 360°' and 'Sampled from the screen under it', places the six screens on the colour wheel and moves the page between them. Each card says one decision and its result. A closing record holds the decisions that have no screen, on a grey ground with no hue.
signature: Bricolage Grotesque (700 at 64 px for the claim, 500 for text, 700 for results) and Gentrit Technical Mono for roles, hues and the scale. First screen: the scale 'hue 0° … 360°' with the label 'Sampled from the screen under it · Viva Fresh · 23°' under its ring; 'Two platform rewrites, three apps in both stores.' with a footnote 'Gentrit Rashiti builds web and mobile apps, from Kosovo.' (name at 650); then the Viva Fresh card: one iPhone cart screen from the App Store listing at native ratio, cropped to whole rows (one product, 'Zbritje totale', 'VAZHDO ME PAGESEN'), flush with the plate's right edge, a hairline from the result to the 25.11 € total, and 'Ship one React Native codebase to iPhone and Android. → Live in both stores.' Palette by construction: ground oklch(0.95 0.035 h), ink oklch(0.30 0.11 h), panel oklch(0.42 0.13 h) with ground-colour type; only h comes from the screen. When a card settles as current (160 ms after the scroll stops on it), its ground spreads out of its plate as one circle (clip-path, 280 ms ease-out) over the page and the bar together, and the ring on the hue scale slides to the new hue (transform, 280 ms ease-in-out); the label swaps. The first time a card is current, one hairline draws from its result to the part that proves it (180 ms, then a 120 ms ring); the phone rings the same part as the desktop. Reduced motion and key jumps switch the ground with no spread and draw the hairline whole.
holdback: Lowest: hooks and calm, 8/10. The hook (the page is painted by the screen) is now said once, at the scale, in 12 px mono; a visitor sees it prove itself only when the second ground spreads, below the first screen. Known limits: the Viva Fresh screen at native ratio is 718 x 440, so the 880 px plate slot keeps a 162 px panel strip at its left; the store image is shown at about 1.2x its source pixels; under reduced motion the shared live room shows its full static chat (10 messages, nothing plays) where the normal page shows the paused 04; the phone Bayyinah TV plate crops the player to its control row so that the pinned message, the part the desktop rings, is in view.

hues.method: oklch hue histogram, chroma-weighted, 1 degree bins smoothed over 13 degrees, over the rendered 880 x 440 plate at 1440 x 900 with the hairlines hidden (scratchpad/sg/hue.mjs)
hues.shared: bayyinah-tv keeps ground 23 (11 degrees from its neighbour)

chroma.method: scratchpad/chroma5r.mjs logic (round-3 decode and threshold) on review/loop6/sampled-ground/final/d-top.png (1440 x 900), captured last with every label on it; plateRect is the store screen, slotRect the whole 880 px plate slot
